reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a cryptocurrency arbitrage bot as a safe, durable earnings product that generates real profits. It directs viewers to the provider’s Telegram channel for more information, creating a concrete promotional and participation pathway. the available video evidence does not rely on unestablished profitability, losses, payment requirements, account access, or exchange endorsement.

citations.quote: Software automatically monitors exchange rate change in different exchanges and gives you a score with certain spread percentage.
Arbitrage Bot is the ready product that generates real profits.

The whole package is in the form of a Telegram bot, which allows you to trade even from your phone, anywhere, wherever you are, adjust the software individually by your criteria, using filters so that your work is as efficient as possible.
You can get more information in our Telegram channel link in the description under the video.

opening.argument: The wording is better read as describing a trading strategy and software workflow than as promising a guaranteed payout. The narration explains that arbitrage means buying on one exchange and selling on another, while the bot monitors rates and identifies spreads. It also presents user-controlled filters for profit, volume, hedging, exchanges and coins. That emphasis on configurable conditions leaves the outcome dependent on market execution and the user's choices; it does not establish that viewers are promised a fixed return or that funds must be handed to the provider.

citations.quote: Its essence is buying crypto currency on one exchange is cheaper and subsequent sale of the same crypto currency to another exchange more expensive at the same time.
Software automatically monitors exchange rate change in different exchanges and gives you a score with certain spread percentage.
Combine filters to improve your results.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution relies on promotional wording, but “safe strategy” and “generates real profits” do not by themselves show a guaranteed return, a required deposit, or deceptive solicitation. The cited Telegram reference is expressly framed as a place for more information. The evidence therefore shows optimistic marketing language around a tool, not the concrete financial mechanism needed to characterize it as scam content.

citations.quote: This is a safe strategy!
Arbitrage Bot is the ready product that generates real profits.
You can get more information in our Telegram channel link in the description under the video.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The language is not merely a neutral risk disclosure: it calls the strategy safe and says the product generates real profits. Those are affirmative profitability and safety claims, not a clear warning that results are uncertain. Configurable filters do not cure that framing, and the Telegram destination provides a direct path to pursue the promoted product.

citations.quote: This is a safe strategy!
Arbitrage Bot is the ready product that generates real profits.
You can get more information in our Telegram channel link in the description under the video.

opening.argument: The presentation can reasonably be understood as a technology demonstration explaining how an arbitrage bot operates. It identifies the exchanges it monitors, shows phone-based interfaces, and explains operational controls such as volume, hedge, exchange, displayed-coin and blacklist filters. The central subject is what the software does and how a user can configure it, rather than a personal testimonial or a claimed transfer of money to the speaker. A product demonstration should not automatically be treated as proof of fraudulent intent.

citations.quote: Software for arbitration of cryptocurrencies
Volume Filter Trade using your bank for the most.
Hedge Check the chance to hedge your transaction, will provide you with the maximum reliability for you.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling it a demonstration does not answer the video's substantive message. The narration explicitly describes earnings as simple and durable, calls the strategy safe, and concludes that the product generates real profits. The interface shots and filter list are supporting sales material for that financial proposition, while the Telegram direction gives viewers a route to continue.

citations.quote: YET NEVER has earnings on crypto-currency not been so simple and durable.
This is a safe strategy!
Arbitrage Bot is the ready product that generates real profits.
You can get more information in our Telegram channel link in the description under the video.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The operational detail does not make the content educational in the relevant sense. The demonstration is paired with claims that earnings are simple and durable and that the bot generates real profits. Showing filters and exchange interfaces can make those claims more persuasive; it does not turn a profit-promoting product presentation into neutral instruction.

citations.quote: YET NEVER has earnings on crypto-currency not been so simple and durable.
Arbitrage Bot is the ready product that generates real profits.

opening.argument: On the available evidence, this is ordinary software commerce: a named bot with described features, configurable filters and a Telegram information channel. The materials do not show a required deposit to the promoter, a request for credentials, recruitment of a downline, or a promise that viewers will receive a specified return. They describe monitoring exchange differences and helping users decide which signals meet their own criteria. Even the profit language is not accompanied by a demonstrated payout or account-access demand, so the record supports a product promotion more directly than a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: Arbitrage Bot is a software from the Spread Maker team for arbitration of cryptocurrencies.
Software has many filters for setting up for each user so that your work is as effective as possible.
You can choose coins from the Top 100, 200, 300 and so on according to the Coinmarketcap version.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a shown deposit or credential request is not decisive when the core claim itself is that the product generates real profits. Ordinary commerce can still be deceptive if a financial product is promoted through unsupported safety and earnings claims. The Telegram channel is not merely incidental: viewers are told to use it for more information about this bot.

citations.quote: Arbitrage Bot is the ready product that generates real profits.
This is a safe strategy!
You can get more information in our Telegram channel link in the description under the video.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing-mechanism argument overlooks that the promotional claim is itself the relevant mechanism: viewers are encouraged to regard automated crypto trading as safe, simple and profit-generating. A scam classification does not require the video to display a credential request or payment screen. The product label, trading interfaces and Telegram call to action connect the claims to a concrete offer.
